purpose: Exploratory isolation of negative-sampling length confound; no downstream or test evaluation
model: unchanged repaired CorrelationModel, 128 hidden / 3 layers / 4 heads / 256 FF / .1 dropout / 64 output
data: existing fixed contextual word caches; train and dev only
eligibility: exclude singleton length groups independently in train/dev; identical eligible anchors and donor pool for both arms
negative_sampling: one nonself donor per anchor, random cyclic permutation globally or within exact retained-word-count group; resampled each epoch with dedicated NumPy RNG
initialization: fresh identical state in both arms, no warm start
stochastic_controls: identical anchor batch order and fixed padding; dropout RNG reset identically at every step; independent sampler RNG
loss: six directed cosine triplet terms summed / 3; margin .2; sample-weighted means
selection: minimum eligible-dev same-length triplet loss, mean of five fixed donor maps; earliest tie; identical criterion in both arms
evaluation: matched vs random/same-length AUC on eligible dev; all-zero original-mask diagnostic; five donor maps; no sentiment test
interpretation: Dev-guided pilot; AUC measures cross-modal pairing, not sentiment relevance or reliability. Compare arms within this protocol, not directly against legacy validation loss. No quantitative success threshold chosen after results.
